title: Theme
description: Light / dark / system: ThemeScript applies the stored theme before paint, ThemeProvider keeps it, ThemeSwitcher (three-way) and ThemeToggle switch it. data-theme on any element re-scopes every token inside it.
when: Once in every app's root layout; the switcher in settings or the sidebar footer.
a11y: ThemeSwitcher is a radio group; nothing is marked selected until the stored theme is known (no flash).

examples.title: Scoped theme
examples.description: data-theme on a wrapper fixes the theme of everything inside it.
